visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Live action. A man in a grey hoodie sits in a brightly lit indoor studio. He looks over his shoulder at the camera with a smile. Behind him, a large computer monitor displays a video of a woman walking in an urban setting. The room has neutral-toned curtains and a white desk. (2) The man faces the camera, sitting at the desk which holds a Samsung monitor, a mechanical keyboard, and a mouse. He gestures towards the screen which shows a group of K-pop idols dancing in a white-themed room. (3) Close-up shots of the monitor screen highlight price tags and high-resolution gameplay from an action RPG. The monitor sits on a sleek silver stand. (4) A macro close-up reveals the top bezel of the monitor where small infrared sensors with glowing red dots are embedded. (5) The man continues his presentation, using hand gestures to explain features. The monitor background changes to show a person standing in a forest, demonstrating depth-of-field layers. (6) A screen capture sequence displays a software interface for '2D to 3D' conversion. (7) Final sequence shows the man talking enthusiastically, gesturing 'rock on' with his hand, while the monitor displays vibrant music video footage in the background.
